data.voice_note: Voces: Erik (probando su invento) y Sofía (jardinera).
data.script: Erik: Invention number twelve: the automatic water machine! … Sofia: I'm planting tomatoes here, Erik. Be careful! … Erik: Don't worry! I'm pressing the green button now… … Sofia: Erik! You are watering MY HAT! … Erik: Oops. Small mistake. Now the red button… … Sofia: Better! Look, the machine is watering the flowers perfectly. … Sofia: And there's a butterfly sitting on it. She thinks it's a big flower! … Erik: Invention number twelve: success! More or less.
